CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 41
   C. 31
   D. 43

2. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

3. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x > 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x < 5

4. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

5. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 2

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 10

7. Solve for x: x + 9 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 9
   C. 6
   D. 14

8. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 7

9. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 3
   D. 13

10. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 0

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

13. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

14. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 36

15. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 56
   C. 15
   D. 57

16. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
